reviews.comment: CSCE 402 is one of the most unique CS classes I have taken so far at TAMU. It's a cybersecurity law class without any real coding or technical knowledge required. Dr. deWitte posted weekly lectures which were very helpful in learning the material and writing the papers for this class. It's a course I recommend taking if you are interested in law.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This was an interesting course, and I learned a lot about cybersecurity law. There were two written exams, one multiple-choice exam, discussion posts, papers, and quizzes. Everything was graded fairly and had clear grading criteria. Also, the professor was reasonable and caring. If you do all the assignments, you should easily get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: just a sad and angry human being. She dont care for student issues

CSCE477-Cybersecurity Risk. She's very established in her field with many years in acadmia and in industry. Thus, her lectures were predominantly discussion based rather than lectures. Easy A as long as you show up. It was 2.5 hours on Fridays but she says it'll be online from here on out.

Going into this class, you hear a lot of good things, but that all ends as soon as class starts. The lectures are a 2 and a half hour chuck on Friday nights that are long and drag on quite a bit (especially since she does not like letting out early). The assignments are easy but be prepared to sit through some long arduous lectures.

She was my professor for 3 classes during my first semester at A&M, never got bored of her classes because of how fun it was to listen to her. If you get the chance to take her class, would highly recommend it since you will definitely end up learning something by the end.

You can tell how passionate she is about her subject. She does her best to engage with the class, take questions throughout the lectures, and bring up real-world relevant topics. She posts the powerpoints online with all the information you need. 

Class is graded off of several small papers. Does not grade hard. 100% will take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: A very understanding professor with incredibly interesting lectures! I've really enjoyed the course thus far. Lots of writing, however.

This class is all writing essays, but DeWitte is incredibly lenient. She's sarcastic, super smart in her field, and just wants you to get something out of cyber law. Most essays are generally 1-2 pages in length and are simple to answer. You don't even really have to take notes in lecture, just listen. I have lots of respect for DeWitte.

She is an amazing professor. If I could, I would take all my courses with her. She cares about what you learn and the classes are fantastic with good discussions. I was looking forward to her class every time. She is reasonable, interesting, unique, resourceful, awesome, knowledgeable, caring and interesting. It can't get better than this.

Get ready to write papers - this class is all essays. That said, you do not have to write a lot (with the exception of the semester paper), and it seems that a lot of the time it is effort graded - as long as you follow the criteria, you'll get a good grade. Her lectures are great, but the class was 2 1/2 hours, so it's quite long.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor. Class is 2.5 hrs but discussion oriented so its not overwhelming. She is willing to give extra time for papers if you need it and very understanding overall. Would recommend everyone takes this class.

I loved class with Prof. DeWitte. She is very understanding and always available outside of class. She genuinely cares about students and wants them to succeed. Her lectures are very relevant to present day situations. There are 5 short papers to write along w/ longer semester paper but is very manageable, not too overwhelming. Def would retake.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures
